scoring_justification: T0 result-level comparison of the final device performance numbers; recomputing from raw EM field artifacts or re-running the full inverse-design pipeline in the verifier sandbox is computationally prohibitive, but the paper-reported values provide a valid monotonic target.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold conversion_efficiency and rejection_power for the TE mode converter
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper reported values: conversion_efficiency = 0.864, rejection_power = 0.007 (Fig. 2 and Section 4.1.1)
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: authoritative published result; matches the reference solve.sh oracle exactly

outputs.description: Device performance: conversion efficiency (fraction of input power into the second-order TE mode) and rejection power (fraction remaining in the fundamental TE mode). Meeting or beating the hidden gold thresholds earns full credit.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares the agent's reported values to gold baseline efficiencies from the paper. The conversion efficiency uses a 'higher is better' criterion; rejection power uses 'lower is better'. Both are scored with threshold_or_better — achieving the gold value or better yields full credit.
